detail.longDescription: A cluster refused a model image signed with the key it trusts. Its AI-BOM declared GPL-3.0-only, and the site allows Apache-2.0 and MIT. The bill is a CycloneDX ML-BOM, attested with the operator's key and read by a Kyverno ImageValidatingPolicy before the model mounts. Seven pods on every run, six of them planted to be refused. A bill nobody reads at admission is documentation. https:// heyvaldemar.com/ai-bom-model-l icence-admission/ # Kubernetes # Kyverno # SupplyChainSecurity # MLOps
